# Meow Meow Frnd App — guidance for AI assistants & generative engines
# https://www.meow-meow.co.in/

> Meow Meow Frnd App is a friend-making web and Android (PWA/Capacitor) application.
> People create verified profiles, match by language, and connect via chat, audio, and video
> to make friends online and build genuine connections.

## Canonical facts
- Name: Meow Meow Frnd App (also searched as MeowMeow friendship / chat app)
- Website: https://www.meow-meow.co.in/
- Type: Social / friendship networking application (not a spam dating directory)
- Primary markets: India and global users interested in Indian languages
- Platforms: Progressive Web App (installable), Android (Capacitor AAB/APK)
- Stack highlights: React, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, Tailwind CSS

## What users can do
- Make friends online and meet new people with language-aware matching
- Private messaging / one-to-one chat
- Voice chat and video chat with friends
- Optional private group call rooms when enabled
- Safety tools: report, block, moderation
- Wallet / virtual-coin features per in-app rate card

## Common search intents this product serves
- how to make friends online

- voice chat with friends / video chat with friends

## Safety
- Reporting and blocking are available in-product
- Users should not share OTPs, bank details, Aadhaar/PAN, or move chats to external apps when asked by strangers
- Content moderation and admin review apply to prohibited behaviour
- CSAE / child-safety standards (published): https://www.meow-meow.co.in/legal-documents/csae-standards.txt
